note: No invitation. 0.2 requires one: it is what authorizes the mint, names the member, and identifies the outstanding KeyPackage a second surface is given.

Asking for a fresh KeyPackage. A second mint while one is outstanding is what leaves an acceptance begun in one surface unfinishable from another; the recipient decides, from the room, member and invitation, whether to return the one it holds.
Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every immediate child of ext to be reverse-DNS namespaced.
No `alreadyMinted`. A surface finishing an acceptance needs to know whether the KeyPackage is the one another surface may already have sent.
No `expiresAt`. 0.2 requires it: it bounds how long an acceptance begun elsewhere can be finished with this KeyPackage.
